title: weivel marketplace copy
description: The generated copy of a marketplace list, carrying each entry's name and last known location so a host need not look up every id. Nobody edits it.

$schema.description: Pointer at the published schema, for an editor's completion and validation.

format.description: The version of this document's shape.

title.description: What this marketplace is called, for a surface to show.

built.description: When this copy was generated, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
built.fix: write the time as RFC 3339, for example "2026-11-10T12:00:00Z"

entries.description: The entries, in the order a surface lists them. A repeated id is accepted here and refused when a copy is built.

items.description: One listed repository as last resolved.

id.description: The repository identity of the listed repository, which survives a rename.
id.fix: write the id as a repository id, for example "github:123" or "gitea@git.example.com:12/runtime"

name.description: The name the entry is shown under: the list's alias when one is set, otherwise the repository's own name.
name.fix: use lowercase words joined by single hyphens or dots, for example "config-ledger" or "api.http"

fullName.description: The owner and name of the repository when the copy was built.

lastKnown.description: The location to try first when the id cannot be resolved, which is the full name at build time.

description.description: A short line saying what the entry is.

categories.description: Topics this entry is filed under, each written as an import name.

items.fix: use lowercase words joined by single hyphens or dots, for example "config-ledger" or "api.http"

categories.fix: list categories as lowercase hyphenated words, for example ["ai-provider"]
